purpose: Durable path-free summary of Keyspilli evidence experiments

entries.purpose: Reduce metal rhythm-wall contamination and source handoffs while preserving vocals and lead detail
entries.route: Demucs/Basic Pitch stems -> source-aware metal arrangement -> learner variants
entries.result: Structural cleanup passed, but residual contour and AMT evidence did not support recognizability.
entries.decision: Keep bounded source-aware cleanup; do not claim musical success.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: delete generated stems/renders after conclusions are recorded

entries.purpose: Collapse guitar harmonic detector stacks into semantic attacks and route rhythm roots to LH
entries.route: source-locked guitar selector -> harmonic clusters -> root/quality stabilization -> chord/LH construction
entries.result: Synthetic harmonic, jitter, root-stability, source-lock, and variant gates passed; real-song listening remained poor.
entries.decision: Preserve implementation and diagnostics; defer further contour research.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: retain summaries only; generated raw outputs are ephemeral

entries.purpose: Compare a private human MIDI reference to generated Defence of Moscow structure
entries.route: private reference MIDI -> local feature/alignment diagnostics only
entries.result: Human reference sounded good; generated direct-metal output was not recognizable. Candidate/reference timing was not silently warped.
entries.decision: Keep references private and evaluation-only; require explicit aligned windows.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: private source retained; no repository copy

entries.purpose: Test Audiveris/HOMR and canonical-spine score extraction as a symbolic alternative
entries.route: private score/PDF -> Audiveris/HOMR -> MusicXML/MIDI -> role/alignment diagnostics
entries.result: Useful engineering diagnostics, insufficient stable coverage/alignment for generation.
entries.decision: Deprioritize OMR as production authority; retain optional local adapter.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: retain compact manifests/reports, delete raster/intermediate output

entries.purpose: Measure raw stem evidence against human references before blaming learner simplification
entries.route: Demucs/Basic Pitch and alternate AMT stems -> raw/decoded/current Easy oracle
entries.result: Timing evidence exists, but pitch fidelity and downstream retention are weak; raw evidence is the limiting oracle.
entries.decision: Do not broaden arranger thresholds without a new evidence source.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: delete WAV/stems after hashes are recorded

entries.purpose: Freeze provenance and alignment status for seven private benchmark songs
entries.route: provider-neutral metadata and permitted local symbolic inputs; benchmark bytes evaluation-only
entries.result: Submitted-local references are musically useful but do not establish independent acquisition or aligned generation evidence.
entries.decision: Keep EXTERNAL_SYMBOLIC_FIRST fail-closed until a candidate has independent alignment.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: retain private originals; delete duplicate downloaded/derived bundles

entries.purpose: Back up local history, preserve conclusions, and reclaim ephemeral experiment storage
entries.route: Git/secret audit -> path-free ledgers -> remote branch/tag -> classified cleanup
entries.result: No protected binaries or credentials found in unpublished history; cleanup is limited to verified generated outputs.
entries.decision: Push topic history and checkpoint tag; retain private sources and unknown/active data.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: see storage-inventory.json and ignored local retention manifest
